definitions.definition_text: Large-funds open float liquidity above old highs or below old lows is generally targeted every quarter. Method: take last three months of data — or last month and a half plus next month and a half — encapsulating ~three months to identify which HTF liquidity pools to focus on.
conditions: ~3-month lookback / lookaround window for pool selection
